How to play

  • Economy — build Lumber Mills beside a Forest, Stone Quarries beside a Mountain, Gold Mines beside a Gold deposit. Find the 3×3 nodes on your half.
  • Troops — build a Barracks, then a Melee Camp / Archery Range to unlock tiers. Recruit in the Army tab (+1/+10/+100), then Form an army.
  • Defense — place auto-firing towers from the Defense tab near your border.
  • Town & Power — houses, markets, churches, squares and trees add Settlement Power; out-power the enemy for a battle damage bonus.
  • Roads / Walls — pick the tool, then tap two points to connect them.
  • The river — the map is split left/right by a river. The enemy half stays hidden by clouds until you build a Bridge across it (Town tab) — it's costly and needs one of every other building first.
  • Attack — only during War (Peace and War alternate, about 1½ min each). Armies cross only on your bridge; the enemy can't use it. Enemy tiles you hold are captured from the bridge outward and turn green.

IRON LINE

Build a settlement, ring it with auto-firing defenses, raise armies in the barracks and command them across the line. Peace lasts 5 minutes, then 1 minute of war \u2014 repeating until a Main Hall falls.
